entry.name: fontSize
entry.label: Lyric text font size in points. -1 uses the panel's default size.

entry.name: widgetWidth
entry.label: Maximum width in pixels of the panel label before eliding.

entry.name: textAlignment
entry.label: Text alignment: left, center or right.

entry.name: showLyrics
entry.label: Show synced lyrics in the panel. When off, only the song name is shown and lyrics aren't fetched.
